remarks: Welcome to this classical yet modern Victorian/Colonial custom built in 2006 located in the sought after Cranbury area. A must see, this timeless treasure is a blend of beauty & modern comfort. Situated within an expansive, beautifully landscaped 1.42 acre setting adjacent to a 2 acre natural preserve.This 5 bdrm 4.5 bath home was freshly updated with modern interior colors making every room inviting with natural lighting. A charming wrap around porch welcomes you into a dramatic 2 story foyer & a flowing main level designed for both entertaining and intimate everyday living. High ceilings, grand moldings, custom detailed stairs, generous room proportions flow freely. The 1st floor primary bdrm suite offers convenience & flexibility, while the expansive gourmet kitchen with an 11 ft island, a large DR & impressive FR provide the heart of the home with access onto the beautiful outdoor patio.The additional generous bdrms & the in-law suite's flexible living space are ideal for guests, extended family or multi-generational needs which completes the 2nd FL. The expansive lower level provides lots of storage & 1,000 SF of recreational fun, family rm or workspaces which exits to a vast lush backyard featuring mature plantings & perennial beds.This well-designed home set against a backdrop of natural surroundings, spacious multiple levels of living space,a 3 car garage & an in-law suite with separate entrance offers comfort & versatility - a rare combination in today's market!
